## 关键发现 ⭐

### 已有自有品牌PoE交换机！
Quantum Star Security 已经在 Intersec 2026 推广自有品牌 **"Quant PoE Switches"**：
- ✅ Unmanaged PoE Switches (208 / 308 / 408 Series) — 非管理型PoE
- ✅ Managed L2/L3 Ethernet Switches (2800 / 3800 / 4800 Series) — 管理型
- ✅ Industrial-Grade PoE Switches (5500 / 6600 / 7200 Series) — 工业级

**这是最理想的OEM客户类型——已经有自有品牌PoE交换机产品线，需要OEM供应商！**

### 代理品牌矩阵
Quantum Star 同时代理:
- **Honeywell** — 安防系统 (欧洲/美国品牌)
- **Hikvision** — 摄像机 (但这是中国品牌，可能受NDAA影响)
- **Hanwha Techwin** — 摄像机 (韩国)
- **Bosch** — PA系统 (德国)
- **CP Plus** — 安防 (印度)
- **Promise** — 存储
- **Vantage** — 控制
- **Escan** — 安检
- **HP** / **WD** / **Cisco** — IT设备

## 合作机会分析

### 方案一：成为Quant PoE交换机供应商（最高价值）
- Quantum已有自有品牌"Quant"，需要稳定的PoE交换机OEM供应商
- Saga可提供全系列产品贴"Quant"品牌
- 价格优势：Saga进货价远低于欧美品牌
- 认证支持：CE/FCC/RoHS齐全

### 方案二：作为其Honeywell/Hanwha配套PoE供应商
- Honeywell/Hanwha摄像机项目需要配套PoE交换机
- Saga可作为更具性价比的配套选项

### 方案三：作为Saga品牌分销商
- 如果Quant不想做OEM，可作为Saga在UAE的分销商

### 邮件切入点
```
Subject: OEM Manufacturing Partner for Quant PoE Switches | Factory Direct Pricing

Dear [Purchasing Manager],

I noticed Quantum Star's impressive Quant PoE Switch line at Intersec and 
was impressed by your comprehensive portfolio from unmanaged to industrial-grade.

We are Saga Telecom — a leading Chinese PoE switch 
manufacturer with CE/FCC/RoHS certifications and 2 years warranty. We believe 
we could serve as an OEM manufacturing partner for your Quant series, offering:

• Full product range matching your 208/308/408/2800/5500/7200 series
• Custom branding, packaging, and firmware options
• 30-50% cost reduction vs current sourcing
• MOQ as low as 50 units per SKU

Would you be open to a quick call to discuss possibilities?

Best regards,
```

## 风险与对策

| 风险 | 对策 |
|------|------|
| 已有稳定供应商 | 提供小批量试单方案+更低价格 |
| 对中国产品质量顾虑 | 提供样品+第三方测试报告+认证 |
| 无本地售后 | 提供延长质保+远程技术支持 |
| NDAA合规问题 | Saga非海康/大华，无合规风险 |
